prompt: In which year did a team achieve the highest score in a World Baseball Classic (WBC) championship game, leading them to victory in their first-ever WBC final?
answer: **2006.** Japan defeated Cuba **10–6** in the inaugural WBC championship game, winning its first-ever WBC final. This remains the highest score by a winning team in a WBC final.
